description: This file defines the 'Version' class responsible for reading and representing version information from a properties file within a Java project. It provides methods for retrieving build version, revision, number, date, and formatted version strings. It also implements comparison based on version components.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents version information for a component, reading data from a version property file, and providing comparison and formatting methods.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Constructs a Version object by reading version info from a resource file location.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Constructs a Version object from a URL pointing to a version property file.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Programmatic constructor to create a version with specified version, revision, and number.

methods.name: getFloatString
methods.description: Returns a string in the format 'version.revision.number'.

methods.name: getVersionString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the version and build number.

methods.name: getBuildDateString
methods.description: Returns the build date as a formatted string.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this version object with another, based on version, revision, and number.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a readable string describing the version.
